ps_sections: What you buy

By signing up you join the CARe Auctions HUB and use the services of your plan: auctions, iCARe, valuations, multilingual chat, iShop, iDream and everything your plan includes. Services start when you pay.
How much you pay and when
You pay the fee of the plan you chose (VAT included where applicable) when you subscribe and then every month, on the same day. If the price changes, we tell you by email at least 30 days in advance.
Renewal and cancellation

The subscription renews automatically every month. You can cancel whenever you like, in one click, from your personal area: cancellation applies from the next cycle, with no penalties and no questions.
3bis
12-month plans
If you choose a 12-month plan (iCARe, iShop or iPartner), you commit for 12 months: you pay the plan fee every month for 12 months, as we show you before payment.
Transaction fees
On iShop purchases and on the transactions included in your plan, a 1% fee applies, capped at €19.90, always shown before you pay.
4bis
Success fee (only if you win)

When iCARe and our team guide you to winning a property, you pay a success fee on the award price: 1.9% up to €200,000, 2.9% above. For assisted resale: 1.5% up to €200,000, 2.5% above. Always shown in advance, and paid ONLY once the result is achieved.
iDream (always optional)
In every payment, as the last item, you can donate to iDream any amount you like, even 1 cent. If you don't turn it on, you donate nothing. 20% of revenue goes to good causes in any case.
Your data
Your data stays yours. We use it only to provide the services, with the highest security, as explained in the Privacy Notice. Never passed to third parties for advertising.
Our commitments
We answer, we help, and iCARe stands by your side. If something isn't right, write to us: info@careauctions.co. We fix it before anything else.
The law
For everything else, Italian law and the court of Cagliari apply. The full clauses are in the Terms and Conditions, which you accept together with this Pact.
